Ishita (CS): Quick sync on Pelmor private VPC onboarding — customer sees KMS 403s from their app and is worried this will delay cutover and trigger renewal conversations.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Can you paste the exact error they see?
Ishita (CS): From their app log:
2026-03-21T10:23:11Z ERROR kms.Client Error: 403 Forbidden - KMSAccessDenied - requestId: a1b2c3d4
Message: User arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/pelmor-app-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/aa11bb22-33cc-44dd-55ee-66778899ff00
Lina (SE): Likely key policy or role permissions. Also check VPC endpoint policy — they mentioned a custom policy on vpce-0f9e8d7c.
Theo (SRE): If they can reach kms endpoint (connection OK) and get 403, calls reach KMS. CloudTrail will show callerIdentity and sourceIP.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Root cause candidates: a) role missing kms:Decrypt, b) key policy denies the current principal (role ARN changed during rotation), c) VPCE policy blocks action.
Lina (SE): Proposed short debug plan: 1) attach minimal role policy allowing kms:Decrypt/Encrypt/GenerateDataKey to pelmor-app-role; 2) apply temporary, account-scoped key policy or allow by sourceVpc; 3) run decrypt test from an instance in their subnet; 4) tighten policies after validation.
Ishita (CS): They requested a live debug session tomorrow 09:00 PST. Can infra make step 1 tonight and step 2 early tomorrow?
Ravi (Eng-Infra): I can apply the role inline policy tonight. Need security signoff for permissive key policy; will request it and schedule the key-policy change for 06:00 PST tomorrow as a temporary window.
Theo (SRE): I'll watch CloudTrail and confirm the kms:Decrypt event and that audit logs are forwarded. After success we should lock key policy to the specific role ARN and add aws:SourceVpc or endpoint conditions as appropriate.
Lina (SE): Test command for customer to run inside VPC: aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.bin --key-id alias/pelmor-key --region us-west-2
Ishita (CS): Also asked about audit log retention: they want one-year retention and SIEM forwarding. Is that part of onboarding?
Lina (SE): We'll provide a sample CloudWatch Logs -> Kinesis Firehose subscription and a Terraform snippet to deliver logs to their SIEM and set retention. I'll add it to the runbook.
DeployBot: change set queued - key-policy-debug-3287654321 (pending approver: Ravi).
Ishita (CS): Owners: Ravi - infra changes & security coord; Lina - policy snippets + runbook + SIEM sample; Theo - audit verification during debug; Ishita - update CS renewal tracker (renewal_risk=elevated until validated). Next check-in: tomorrow 17:00 PST.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Will ping when changes are live.
Ishita (CS): Thanks all :thumbsup:
